{{Top}}
[[File:Kabe-hd.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Kabe/Legends|Kabe]] reaches for a cup of Juri juice.]]

'''Juri juice''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|inebriating]] and addictive<ref name="When the Desert Wind Turns: The Stormtrooper's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=When the Desert Wind Turns: The Stormtrooper's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> drink favored by [[Kabe/Legends|Kabe]] at the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]]. It was sold in variously-sized and -colored collectible [[Juri jar|jars]].

Many different flavors for juri juice existed, the most notable of which was made from a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian's]] [[Blood/Legends|blood]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace video game'']], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] has to offer some juri juice to one of [[Watto/Legends|Watto's]] workers, in order to convince him to lead him to Watto, so he could negotiate about setting [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] free. The item description describes it as a type of ale originating on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
